definitions.explanation: The winter months, usually when talking about what happens or is needed during that season.

examples.japanese: {冬場|ふゆば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The air gets dry in winter.

examples.japanese: {冬場|ふゆば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暖房費|だんぼうひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさむ。
examples.english: Heating costs pile up in wintertime.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冬場|ふゆば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This road is often closed by snow in the winter months.

notes:
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧ (winter) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (period). Used like ⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧ for the season as a period that brings particular conditions, costs or business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冬場|ふゆば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧: winter dryness
- {冬場|ふゆば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧: winter electricity bills
- {冬場|ふゆば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{限|かぎ}る→限る：02033_kagiru⟧: to be limited to winter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧: winter; the general word
- ⟦{冬季|とうき}→冬季：11755_touki⟧: winter season; formal, used in official contexts (⟦{冬季|とうき}→冬季：11755_touki⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧)
